newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ST Aerospace soars on good interim profit.
newsitem.headline: ST Aerospace soars on good interim profit.

text.p: Singapore Technologies Aerospace Ltd shares hit a new year high in early morning trade on Tuesday after it posted strong earnings for the half year ended June 30, 1997.
At 0105 GMT, the shares were up Singapore $0.52 at S$2.85 with over 329,000 shares traded.
The aircraft maintenance company, 67 percent owned by the government's Singapore Technologies Pte Ltd, reported net profit more than tripled to S$28.01 million from last year's S$6.86 million.
The group also declared for the first time an interim dividend of five percent.

Group president and chief executive Boon Swan Foo told a news briefing he expected the group's strong performance to be sustained in the second half which would bring 1997 profits to around S$56 million.
The group's profits were sharply above market expectations of about S$36 million for the full year.
